title: Counter scan initialization
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ and $s$ be Boolean words, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for input $x$. Fix functions giving the contents and head positions of the $K$ work tapes. For every natural number $j$ with $j\le |s|$, the clock machine, started in its counter-scan state with buffer tape containing $s$ and buffer-head position $j-1$, reaches after $j+1$ steps the input configuration unchanged, with the buffer head at position $0$ and the clock state in its input-start state.
hypotheses_covered: fixed contents function for the $K$ work tapes
fixed head-position function for the $K$ work tapes
